cases.fixtureKind: Synthetic ward=1e15 on an otherwise naturally reached valid combat state; not a natural reward.

method: Seed 3 starts from newGame. Every subsequent native game action is compared recursively with the complete engine transition, including RNG, runId, revision and assets. Read-only comparisons check both exact stored envelopes. Layout fixtures continue that natural sequence; the large-ward boundary is separately marked synthetic.
limitations: Logical viewports at scale 1 with software rendering; no physical mobile, 4K GPU, native IME or audio assessment.
Screenshots and functional waits are not performance measurements.
This selected natural seed demonstrates explanation accuracy; it is not a win-rate sample.
